items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Yeah, I don't know him at all lately. You know him if you saw him.

ctx.x: You don't belong to them, you're not a big joiner? No, no, I don't belong to nothing like that. Did you ever belong to make insurances or...? Well I was, at one time, I used to be a salesman for Unity Insurance Company. Oh, I see. And then I was known widely from that, with the other companies too, you see. You know, the companies, they, they pretty much all, the agents pretty much know all, all agents from other companies. You meet them on the street, see. Yeah. Yeah. I knew plenty of people like that too.
Tony Fugero is one, you know him? Who? Tony Fugero. He's right, but he used to play in mixed bands here and there. Yeah, I don't know him at all lately. You know him if you saw him.
Were there, by the police, me to ask you, were there any mixed bands in the way back when you started?
